metadata._comment: USE CASE: an ARM template whose triggerThreshold is a parameter with no default value, so it arrives as the literal string [parameters('threshold')]. On 2026-09-16 the converter read four such rules and assessed two: the normalizer warned that 'everything else converts normally' and the engine then threw on an [int] cast, and the rule vanished with no verdict. EXPECT: NeedsWork - the trigger threshold is dropped (it has no XDR equivalent) and the rule is still assessed. Also nested under a Microsoft.Resources/deployments resource, which the template walker did not descend until the same day.

properties.displayName: Sample - Threshold from an ARM parameter
properties.description: The threshold is a deployment-time parameter with no default.
properties.query:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where ActionType == 'LogonFailed'
| summarize Failures = count() by DeviceName, AccountName
| where Failures > 5
